occurrences.quote_span: Pakistan’s government has provided fuel subsidies to more than 9 million low-income people as the U.S.-Iran war drives up energy prices, officials said Tuesday.

occurrences.subject: Pakistan fuel subsidy program

occurrences.checkable_against: Jamaat-e-Islami public statements and Pakistan government subsidy announcement
occurrences.quote_span: The subsidies were announced after Jamaat-e-Islami, Pakistan’s major Islamist political party, threatened to march on Islamabad to pressure the government to cut taxes on petrol and diesel.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pakistan fuel subsidy program

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Pakistan Information Technology Minister Shaza Fatima Khawaja about subsidy delivery

occurrences.speaker: Shaza Fatima Khawaja
occurrences.subject: Pakistan fuel subsidy program

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Pakistan Information Technology Minister Shaza Fatima Khawaja about the fuel subsidy program
occurrences.quote_span: Information Technology Minister Shaza Fatima Khawaja said the program was designed to ease the burden on millions of people as regional geopolitical tensions drove up global fuel prices.

occurrences.subject: Pakistan fuel subsidy program
